title: Lynkk for HR Teams: Interview Notes and Feedback Without the Typing

lines: Interview after interview, and the feedback lives in someone's head.
By the debrief, nobody is sure who said what.
Scorecards come in late, notes are thin, and good candidates wait.
And the debrief turns into a guessing game.
Lynkk records the interview, online or in person,
so you can listen instead of typing.
After each interview, the Meeting Brief lists the takeaways, the open questions, and next steps with an owner.
Every timestamp plays the moment it was said.
Ask Lynkk what a candidate said in any round.
And set a sensitive 1:1 to Personal, so only you can see it.
Write feedback by talking. Hold a key on the Mac, and the words land where your cursor is.
Listen to people. Lynkk takes the notes.
